claim_ceiling: A PASS establishes only that the specifically bounded corpus manifest satisfies this documentation preflight contract at the frozen repository state. It does not constitute legal advice or establish universal copyright clearance, semantic correctness, institutional authority, benchmark validity, production readiness, or enterprise readiness.
fail_closed_conditions: bounded corpus membership cannot be reconciled exactly to manifest rows

acquired_or_generated_at.rule: RFC 3339 date-time identifying acquisition or generation time

local_path.rule: repository-relative path to the bounded source object; must not use an absolute path or parent traversal

notes.rule: free text; must not substitute for any required evidence field

provenance_evidence.rule: non-empty URI or repository-relative tracked evidence reference supporting source origin

redistribution_status.pass_rule: must not be unknown; not_permitted does not by itself fail bounded internal evaluation if the recorded rights_basis permits that use

rights_evidence.rule: non-empty URI or repository-relative tracked evidence reference supporting rights_basis

source_id.rule: non-empty string; unique across manifest; must be the identifier used to bind the corresponding SourceDocument

source_locator.rule: canonical public locator when public, or stable synthetic origin identifier when synthetic

gate_pass_rule: manifest exists, contains header plus at least one data row, exact header order matches this contract, every row passes, every bounded source intended for the corpus is represented exactly once, and no undeclared source is used by the bounded corpus evaluation
normalization_policy: NONE: validator must report invalid evidence and must not silently repair, infer, fetch, rewrite, or normalize manifest values
